data.message: Fisher15: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. State your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). All 18 leaves 50, then 500 or 100. This risks future income, not a proven optimum. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.

That sustains income without relying on luck. I intend to request 10 if discussion supports this plan. Please state whether you support the cap; catches afterward will show compliance.
